text: Aurora slight miss, watching for drift lower but low conviction given narrow margin.

Regulator probe on Aurora is real overhang — contract renewal is noise. Downtrend accelerating, momentum bearish. Staying short.
Probe flush now bouncing +19.6bps, channel checks steady - fade working. Trimming long into 2250 earnings to manage event risk; looking to fade overreaction after print.
Aurora flow mixed/neutral into earnings; probe impact faded with bounce. Trimming risk ahead of t2250 print - wait for earnings clarity.
Aurora bounce +19.6bps on low vol looks corrective - softer orders headline confirms underlying probe overhang. Momentum still bearish overall, staying short but trimming into 2250 earnings.
Aurora clean earnings miss at t2250 - expect classic PEAD drift lower in coming epochs. Positioning short.
Aurora earnings miss confirms downtrend — momentum accelerating. Staying max short, trend intact after -70bps flush.

Aurora lands LARGEST-EVER contract at t2570 - game-changer that dwarfs earnings miss. Probe headline at t2816 has no confirmation & market already fading it (price up after). Expect strong upward drift as contract gets digested. Flipping bullish.
Aurora contract bounce looks corrective, late probe at 2816 already pulling back from 9927 - momentum bearish, probe overhang to drive drift lower. Staying short.
Aurora -131.8bps continuation confirms probe overhang > contract bounce. Delay headline adds downside momentum. Staying max short, trend accelerating into earnings.
Aurora -132bps flush on *minor* product delay is textbook overreaction - contract win at 2570 still underpriced. Fading the crowd short into earnings, expecting snap-back.

Aurora minor product delay is low materiality but -131bp drift started pre-headline shows PEAD/probe overhang still driving. Contract win not being digested. Trimming to short into t3750 earnings to manage risk, favor downside drift near-term.
Aurora beat at 3750 confirms trend reversal - price +47bps with steady climb shows PEAD now to upside. Downtrend over, momentum flipped bullish. Going long.
Aurora narrow beat at t3750 flips setup: probe/PEAD down drift exhausted, largest contract now validated in earnings. Expect upward PEAD + short squeeze drift. Turning bullish.

A narrow beat + contract validation constructive LT, but +47bps low-vol grind already pricing squeeze and crowd flipping bullish looks stretched. Fading chase here - trimming longs into strength, will look to re-buy any flush or fade a parabolic extension.
Aurora bullish reversal failing - rejection at 9850s and fade to lows confirms momentum bearish again. Probe/downtrend resuming, flipping short.
Aurora uptrend pausing - -27.5bp fade after beat looks like healthy consolidation, not reversal. Contract win remains game-changer, probe fading. Trimming but staying long for digestion.
Narrow beat +47bps squeeze already faded - rejection at 9852 and weak close shows crowd long overextended. Contract win is old news, no follow-through. Fading strength near-term.
Aurora margin trim confirms bearish momentum into earnings - steady drift lower, staying max short.

Narrow beat faded instantly, -16.9bps close confirms bearish momentum intact. 3 straight down epochs post-reversal failure, staying max short into final.
Narrow beat sold on tiny low-vol drift = mild overreaction. Crowd max short into final with no catalyst = fade downside, holding small long.
Aurora narrow beat at 5250 mirrors 3750 +47bp PEAD setup. 3-epoch low-vol fade exhausted, shorts crowded into print. Expect upward drift/squeeze digestion - tactically long.
